title: HAProxy High Availability Load Balancing
summary: Clients reach a keepalived-managed floating IP. The active HAProxy applies ACLs, health-checked backends and PROXY protocol to reach servers.

nodes.label: Clients
nodes.detail: Connect to a single virtual IP and are unaware of which load balancer node currently answers.

nodes.label: Floating VIP
nodes.detail: Virtual IP owned by whichever node is VRRP MASTER. On failure it moves to the BACKUP within a few seconds.

nodes.label: keepalived MASTER
nodes.detail: Sends VRRP advertisements and tracks a HAProxy health script. Higher priority wins the election.

nodes.label: keepalived BACKUP
nodes.detail: Listens for advertisements. If they stop, it claims the VIP and sends gratuitous ARP.

nodes.label: HAProxy Frontend
nodes.detail: Terminates or passes through TCP/TLS, evaluates ACLs on host, path or SNI, and chooses a backend with use_backend rules.

nodes.label: HAProxy Backend
nodes.detail: Distributes requests using roundrobin or leastconn. Active health checks mark servers up or down and remove failed ones from rotation.

nodes.label: Server A
nodes.detail: Backend application server. Receives client details via PROXY protocol or X-Forwarded-For.

nodes.label: Server B
nodes.detail: Second backend server. Can be drained with maintenance mode for zero-downtime deploys.

nodes.label: Stats Page
nodes.detail: HAProxy stats and runtime API expose session counts, server state and health check results.

steps.title: Clients target the VIP
steps.text: Clients resolve one address. It is a VRRP virtual IP, not tied to a single machine.

steps.title: MASTER owns the VIP
steps.text: keepalived on the MASTER advertises priority, and traffic lands on its HAProxy frontend.

steps.title: ACLs pick a backend
steps.text: The frontend matches host, path or SNI via ACLs and routes to the right backend pool.

steps.title: Health checks gate servers
steps.text: The backend only sends traffic to servers passing health checks, using PROXY protocol to preserve client IP.

steps.title: Failover on MASTER loss
steps.text: If advertisements stop, the BACKUP takes the VIP and its HAProxy continues serving.
